name: How does wood siding compare to fiber cement siding in terms of durability and maintenance?

mainEntity.name: How does wood siding compare to fiber cement siding in terms of durability and maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wood siding offers a classic aesthetic and can be very durable with proper maintenance, but it requires regular painting or staining and can be susceptible to rot, pests, and fire. Fiber cement siding is highly durable, rot-resistant, insect-resistant, and fire-resistant, requiring less maintenance overall. While fiber cement may not offer the exact natural look of wood, advancements in its manufacturing have created options that mimic wood grain effectively. Your choice depends on aesthetic preference and desired maintenance level.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood offers natural beauty but requires more maintenance; fiber cement is more durable, fire-resistant, and requires less upkeep.
